name: Wild Witch
detailed_description:
WILD WITCH

Become a Hero or Horror?

Resurrect. Hunt. Decide.
Wild Witch is a cozy horror roguelike where you play as a resurrected nature goddess exploring a corrupted World Tree. Master strategic vine-based combat, make morally weighty choices, and decide whether to save or consume the creatures you encounter.

EMBRACE THE DUALITY

Choose your path between corruption and purification as you reclaim your fragmented powers. Each run shapes your abilities, transforming both your appearance and the environment around you.

  • Corruption Path: Devour creatures for immediate power, manipulate terrifying vine-tentacles, and spread fear through the land

  • Purification Path: Tame companions, heal corrupted landscapes, and cultivate gardens of mystical flora

MASTER STRATEGIC COMBAT

Discover and wield a vast arsenal of living weapons that evolve based on your moral choices:

  • Vine Lance: Pierce multiple enemies with precision strikes

  • Thorny Whip: Control crowds with sweeping attacks

  • Flowering Bloom: Release devastating area effects

  • Parasitic Tendril: Drain essence from enemies for sustain

Combine weapons with elemental magics to create devastating synergies and unique builds every run.

EXPLORE A TWISTED WORLD TREE

Venture through procedurally generated biomes with hand-crafted elements:

  • Whispering Woods: Dark forests where trees whisper forgotten memories

  • Shadowfen: Mist-shrouded swamps hiding ancient ruins

  • The Sacrificial Altar: Your ever-changing hub between runs

FEATURES:

  • Roguelike Progression: Permanent unlocks and meta-progression between runs

  • Moral Choice System: Shape your powers and the world through your actions

  • 2-Player Co-op: Team up with a friend as twin aspects of the Wild Witch

  • Strategic Combat: Master a diverse arsenal of living weapons

  • Horror Elements: Face grotesque enemies and unleash terrifying powers

  • Rich Lore: Uncover the mystery of the World Tree and your fragmented existence

Will you become the hero who heals the World Tree, or the horror that consumes it? The choice is yours.
